decisions.statement: A process is present only where the pid is there and its start tick is the tick held.
A pid the kernel no longer names is absent.
A pid whose stat file will not read is unknown rather than absent.
A page naming no process at all is absent rather than unknown.
Only a process named and unreadable leaves whether an agent is there unknown.
A key is written as the pid and a hyphen and the start ticks.
A key is read back across a hyphen or a dot.
A key stated as anything but two whole numbers is no key.

definition: a pid held together with the tick its process started at, so a reused pid reads as gone
